reasons.reader_question: The glint ending makes the watcher, and Mini's exposure on the short way, concrete; Pritam's wound is left half-open.
reasons.change: Knowledge shifts (a watcher, the cover-sheet clause), Kunal rejects Dhanu's bright line, and he nearly discloses.
reasons.romance_movement: There is a new reason. Ila declines his rehearsed half, and that disarms him into an unprompted, uncalculated start at the truth.
reasons.shown_chemistry: Responsive beats: 'I'll take the half', the blank page, her glance at his fingertips, and the echo of Mini's voice.
reasons.character_logic: Mostly sharp. Ila overclaims what the glass pointed at earlier, and Kunal asserts digging he hasn't witnessed.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: Refusing Dhanu's plan sends Dhanu ahead and leaves Mini in open view. The whistle joke makes the cost ominous.
reasons.prose: Clean, concrete and varied, with no banned phrases. The Mini-scene interiority turns briefly expository, and one gaze line is clumsy.
reasons.continuity: This matches F468, F470, F471, F475, F476, F682 and F683, the three prior cuffs, and his age of 33 (24 years since nine).

fixes: At 'It was pointed at the hamlet before we came up', Ila claims knowledge she cannot have. The sun has only just cleared the ridge, and she would not sit on an earlier sighting. This is a character-logic slip. Cut the claim or ground it: 'It's pointed at us now. If it's been there since yesterday, it watched the hamlet all afternoon.' This also sets up Kunal's turn to the short way.

At 'Raghu's pairs are on the Hollow Moon now, digging for something', Kunal states as fact what the runner never saw. F468 records only that they passed heading for the Moon. Make it inference: 'Raghu's pairs went up the Hollow Moon two days ago, and nobody climbs there in winter to admire it.' Then the digging lands as discovery later.

The interior run from 'A number was a way, as a name was a way' to 'people went there too' explains the theme instead of dramatising it. Cut to two sentences and give Kunal an action, such as calling Mini over to sing her rhyme while she paces. Also replace 'She held his gaze, and so did he' with a concrete beat, e.g. 'She didn't look away. Neither did he.'
reader_question: Who is watching Ewe's Rest through a glass, and did they follow Dhanu, Gauri and Mini down the short way?
new_facts_assessment: Both listed facts are necessary and consistent. The mile of open ground under the outcrop sets up the threat to Dhanu's party, and Kunal's refusal is the beat's decision. Unlisted but consistent details: the short way needs no rope below the snow-line (fits F666), and the 'high way' whistle signal (fits F470).
